page.content:
The long imperial peace advertised from Augustus through the Antonines.

How Pax Romana connects

  • Character: Augustus — Augustus advertised the Pax Romana as the fruit of his settlement.
  • Character: Trajan — Trajan's reign is counted inside the high imperial peace.

What is Pax Romana?

Pax Romana is the ideology and, in the Mediterranean core, the practice of reduced civil war and secured seas — paid for by frontier armies and provincial taxation.

Key threads lead to Augustus and Trajan.
